description:
## [2.0.1](https://github.com/YYDarlinker/morphe-ai-caption-translator/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1) (2026-11-28)

> **Requires Morphe Manager 2.8.0+ or Morphe Desktop 2.4.0+** (built on Morphe Patcher 2.6.0; Manager 2.7.x and earlier are no longer supported).

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Automatic thinking-mode control**: Automatically disables thinking—or selects the lowest supported reasoning effort—to lower latency and API cost across major providers and regional endpoints (including OpenAI, Azure, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Bailian, SiliconFlow, Zhipu, Volcengine, and custom gateways). Response-format fallbacks no longer turn thinking back on for subsequent requests.
* **Cleaner replies & Test API**: Strips leading `<think>` blocks from both streamed and non-streamed replies so they never break subtitle parsing, shows a notice in Test API when a model or gateway still uses reasoning, and updates the default model for new setups to `deepseek-flash`.

### Included from v2.0.0

* **Player controls avoidance**: Captions smoothly move above the bottom seekbar, timestamps, and controls when they appear, and return once controls hide.
* **Improved caption dragging**: Long-press dragging now reaches the safe video edges and stays stable across subtitle gaps.
* **Morphe-aligned settings UI**: Redesigned settings, opacity slider, and diagnostics dialogs to match Morphe's rounded style, with inline API profile rename/delete and pre-filled default names.
* **Toolchain & bundle**: Upgraded to Gradle 9.9.1 and Patcher 2.x APIs, reducing `.mpp` size by over 20%.
* **Compatibility & upgrade**: Verified with Official Morphe Patches `2.4.0` on YouTube `21.30.216` (stable) and `21.47.483` (experimental). Upgrading over `v1.6.2` automatically migrates existing settings, API profiles, and Keystore-encrypted keys.
